predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Atalanta vs Inter: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Absences & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Inter project to claim an away victory in an open, multi-goal contest in Bergamo, backed by their 2.64 xG attacking baseline against a depleted Atalanta defense.

spf.comment: Inter's 2.64 xG attack and second-half scoring depth overpower an Atalanta defense missing Hien and Kossounou for a 1:2 or 1:3 away victory.

over_under.comment: A 3.55 combined lambda, 68.8% Poisson Over 2.5 projection, and Atalanta's 83.3% home Over 2.5 rate strongly support three or more goals.

score.comment: 1:2 is the modal Poisson outcome (9.4%) capturing Atalanta's home threat and Inter's edge, with 1:3 (6.8%) covering late counter-attacking separation.

goals.comment: Poisson goal probabilities peak at 3 goals (21.4%) and 4 goals (19.0%), matching both projected scorelines in an open tactical exchange.
